login.title: Login
login.description: Enter your credentials to access your account.

register.title: Register
register.description: Create a new account to start chatting.

createGroupDialog.title: Create a new group
createGroupDialog.description: Enter a name for your new group. You can invite others later.
createGroupDialog.createdDescription: Share this ID with others to let them join your group.

joinGroupDialog.title: Join an existing group
joinGroupDialog.description: Enter the Group ID you received to join the chat.

leaveGroupDialog.confirmDescription: You are about to leave the group "{groupName}". You will no longer be able to see messages or participate in this group. This action cannot be undone.

deleteGroupDialog.title: Are you absolutely sure?
deleteGroupDialog.description: This will permanently delete the group '{groupName}' and all of its messages for everyone. This action cannot be undone.

welcome.title: Welcome to groupchat
welcome.description:
Select a group from the sidebar to start chatting,
or create a new group to get started.
